full_judgment:
Borhanuddin J: This Rule has been issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioner Advocate Ruhul Kabir Rizvi should not be enlarged on bail in GR No.122 of 2013 arising out of Pal tan Model Police Station Case No.21 dated 12-3-2013, under sections 143/147/148/149/186/253/332/333/307/ 427/114/34 of the Penal Code read with Sections 3/4/6 of the Explosive Substances Act, 1908, pending in the court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka, and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. Facts leading to disposal of the Rule are that one Md Alauddin, ASI of Police on 12-3-2013 being informant lodged a First Information Report with Paltan Model Police Station stating inter alia that on 11-3-2013 at about 15-00 hours Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) with 18 parties alliance arranged a: meeting in front of BNP central office at Nayapaltan. All on a sudden at about 16-45 hours, under the leadership of accused Nos. 1-6, the other accused-persons named in the FIR alongwith 50/60 unknown persons with deadly weapons created obstruction on the road and damaged buildings adjacent to the road. Accused Nos. 1-6 announced through loud-speakers and instigated the other accused-persons to do so. They threw 18/20 cocktails and set fire by burning tyre, wood and papers on the road. Public on fear ran here and there. To control the situation, companions of the informant fired from their shot guns. From BNP Central Office two cocktails were thrown upon the police. Then the police entered into the BNP office, searched the office and recovered 10 hand bombs and arrested 154 persons including the accused petitioner. Police prepared two seizure lists in presence of the witnesses. On the basis of the FIR, Paltan Model Police Station Case No.21 dated 12-3- 2013 under sections 143/147/148/149/186/253/ 332/333/307/427/114/34 of the Penal Code read with sections 3/4/6 of the Explosive Substances Act 1908, was registered.
